title: Deep learning diagnoses intraoperative frozen thyroid lesions on whole slide images
summary: A deep learning classifier assigned frozen thyroid sections to five categories and reached test accuracy 0.9459 and AUC 0.9955 on slides from 4409 sections. It also detected 101 papillary microcarcinoma sections and was evaluated on 1388 external whole slide images. Main metrics come from six-fold cross-validation in a retrospective study; the external metrics were not reviewed.
ai_technology: Deep-learning whole slide image classifier with a two-step cancer and subtype judgment

evidence.tested: Six-fold cross-validation, 101 papillary microcarcinoma sections and an external dataset of 1388 slides.
evidence.unknown: External-set performance and prospective use during surgery.
